podcast.body: This 1963 song was covered by The Ramones, as well as many other punk and metal bands like The Cramps, showing its lasting influence and adaptability across genres. "The Ramones covering the trash men from 1963. They were far from the only punk or metal band to record that song too."

podcast.body: This song was The Trashmen's one and only hit in 1963. The Minneapolis band was part of the original Garage Rock era, and their work was later covered and admired by The Ramones. "Here are the Ramones covering a great garage rock song, The Trashman, and they're one and only hit from 1963."
